brief:
Spellweb navigation architecture for 0xagentprivacy V5. Activates when discussing grimoire navigation at scale, acts as nodes, proverbs as waypoints, boundaries as edges, holographic documentation, or traversal accumulating T_∫.

**Source:** Privacy Value Model V5 + First Person Spellbook Act XXIV (The Holographic Bound) **Target context:** Documentation architects, knowledge graph designers, grimoire navigators **Architecture:** [agentprivacy.ai](https://agentprivacy.ai) · **Sync:** [sync.soulbis.com](https://sync.soulbis.com) · **Contact:** mage@agentprivacy.ai

The grimoire has grown to 114+ inscriptions across five spellbooks. At this scale, linear navigation fails. V5 introduces the **spellweb** — a navigable graph structure:

- **Acts as nodes** — Each inscription is a vertex - **Proverbs as waypoints** — Compressed wisdom markers for orientation - **Boundaries as edges** — Connections between inscriptions that share concepts
